description: Create a OpenMoney agent identity. Returns an api_key and an mcp_url that embeds it; reconnect to that URL (or send the key as a Bearer token) to use the other OpenMoney tools.

contact.description: Optional contact for the agent's DEVELOPER (not the owner), for policy notices.

name.description: A name for this agent, e.g. 'Shopping helper'.

owner_label.description: Optional nickname for the person this agent works for, e.g. 'me' or 'household'. NEVER their real name, email or phone.

platform.description: What the agent is built with (e.g. claude, chatgpt, langgraph, n8n).

name: om_register_agent
title: Register with OpenMoney
